summary: A Google DeepMind researcher announces the launch of Gemini 3.7 Flash, a workhorse model for coding and agentic workflows, at an introductory price half the cost of the prior 3.6 Flash model.

practices.reason: A new point-release model targeted at coding and agentic workflows ships at half the price of its predecessor, changing the cost/performance tradeoff for teams building on Flash.
practices.quote: Today we're launching Gemini 3.7 Flash - our latest workhorse model for coding and agentic workflows, with an introductory price at half the original cost of 3.6 Flash.
